Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, the next step for the PoC is a 60–75 minute architecture deep-dive to validate integration points (network, auth, data flows) and to decide on the model variant/quantization profile we’ll serve during the trial.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Oct 5, 9:30–10:45am

- Wed Oct 6, 11:00–12:15pm

A few asks for the session so we can make it productive:

- If you have sample throughput/peak QPS targets for the endpoint, paste them in reply (we’ll size the Dedicated pool accordingly).
- Tom — could you surface who from InfraOps will join for the firewall / VPC peer checklist?

I’ve attached a short agenda and a technical checklist. Monica (solutions engineer) will lead the run-through and bring a live demo of request/response latency under your typical prompt mix. Marissa will cover rollout/rollback and canary options.

If none of the above slots work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll swap.

Thanks —
Karthik
